title: Attio platform tour
description: A long product tour on pale grey inside the hairline page frame: a two-tone intro statement, then a sticky left rail of five chapter names (a sideways tab strip under the header on phones) beside the chapters. Each chapter is a 24px two-tone statement, a wide grey well holding a product shot, and two small panels split by a hairline. The chapter in view turns dark in the rail with a blue rule; wells rise out of a blur and panels scale up as they enter.
notes: every well and panel is a media slot; empty, wells show a white card placeholder and panels a grey surface
the rail and the phone strip stick under a 116px / 100px header
chapter ids become anchors; give them unique ids on the page
